concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create concept A for Billy-Joe (BJ), original slightly anthropomorphized SERVER RACK AI character for an absurd plumbing action game. ONE full-body server cabinet, three-quarter front view, generous margins, portrait composition, plain muted charcoal studio backdrop. Sophisticated cinematic realistic industrial concept art. Design A: THE SUPERVISOR. Tall standard rectangular graphite 42U server rack, orange corner trim and small BJ asset badge. Many unmistakable rackmount computer servers with screws, removable hot-swap disk trays, ethernet ports and status LEDs. Near upper quarter, a shallow wide black diagnostic display has two small amber rectangular eye-like status graphics; one subtly raised horizontal brow suggests a confident office supervisor. A short segmented activity meter below suggests a restrained mouth. Face is integrated into actual rack equipment, not a separate head. Broad flat cabinet top, restrained vents, sturdy plinth; no arms or legs. Rack reads first as actual data center equipment, then a person. Slightly officious, fallible, useful, not sinister. Crisp tactile metal, tiny restrained amber and green lights. No toilet shapes, ceramic bowls, plumbing pipes, valve wheels, gauges, halos, single central eye, spherical robots, recognizable existing sci-fi designs, weapons or corruption. No text except a small readable BJ badge. Not a comic human or a robot wearing a rack. Output one polished design mockup only.

Design B: THE OLD HAND. A squat broad 24U rack of aging enterprise computers in warm beige painted steel, dark olive-gray panels, black exposed mounting rails, stacked disk arrays, ventilation grilles and dense tiny status lamps. A small recessed GREEN MONOCHROME diagnostic CRT integrated upper-center shows two simple eye-like square cursor blocks and a very short flat line mouth, one eye fractionally higher, giving dry skeptical personality. Wide square chassis, modest panel asymmetry, floppy service keyboard shelf folded closed below, faded small BJ inventory badge and minor repair patches. Industrial solid foot plinth, no human arms or legs, no separate head. Recognizably a working server rack with restrained personality, confident veteran office equipment. No toilet shapes, porcelain, plumbing pipes, valves, gauges, spherical AI, central camera eye, recognizable existing sci-fi characters, corruption, menace or weaponry. No text except BJ badge. One polished design mockup only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create concept C for Billy-Joe (BJ), original slightly anthropomorphized SERVER RACK AI character for an absurd plumbing action game. ONE full-body server cabinet, three-quarter front view, generous margins, portrait composition, plain muted charcoal studio backdrop. Sophisticated cinematic realistic industrial concept art. Design C: THE DISTRIBUTED MIND. Tall narrow dark navy steel server rack with a slightly offset shorter sidecar UPS cabinet, believable stacked rackmount blades, hot-swap drives, perforated cooling panels and neatly bundled ethernet cables visible only inside one side recess. Its face is subtle physical pareidolia: two small separated horizontal banks of cyan activity LEDs at upper third suggest eyes, one bank angled by a tilted removable module suggesting a raised eyebrow; one thin amber network-traffic meter lower down hints at a mouth. NO screen with drawn cartoon face. Asymmetric but plausible service hardware silhouette, matte blue metal, tasteful copper-colored rack handles not pipes, small BJ badge. A confident all-seeing bureaucrat suggested by a machine, not a humanoid robot. No arms, legs or separate head. No toilets, ceramic, pipes, valves, gauges, glowing central eye, spherical robot, recognizable existing AI designs, corruption or villain effects. No text except BJ badge. One polished design mockup only.
